name: Config error: storage_mode 'Column' is not a valid value
description: storage_mode differing only in case must be rejected (issue #187). This value is one of the two that diverged across runtimes before #179: pine-java matched with equalsIgnoreCase so it selected column storage, while pine-go selected row. The byte-identical claim is pinned by wrapping_exact rather than only asserted in prose: with message_contains alone, rewording one runtime's message left section 05 green, so the claim had no gate at all. 注意 `wrapping_exact` 是**包含**匹配（`05-error-parity.sh` 用 `grep -qF`），不是相等匹配：它钉住的是消息**前缀**，某一方在末尾**追加**内容不会让它变红——实测给 pine-go 的文案加 " (see docs)" 后 section 05 仍 35/35 全绿。所以这条 fixture 钉的是「前缀一致」，不是完整的字节对等；中段改词会红（已验证），尾部追加不会。

expected_error.wrapping_exact: pine: config error: storage_mode "Column" is invalid, must be "row" or "column"
